# Portfolio Website Analytics

This page summarizes traffic and engagement data collected from my portfolio website using Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Search Console.

---

# Tools Used

- Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
- Google Search Console
- Google Tag Manager
- Quarto
- GitHub Pages

---

# Traffic Insights

The website analytics helped track:

- Total users and sessions
- Traffic acquisition channels
- User engagement behavior
- Website performance trends
- Search visibility and discoverability

---

# Key Takeaways

- Most traffic came from direct and organic sources
- User engagement increased after improving page structure
- Analytics provided insight into how visitors interacted with project pages
- GA4 helped evaluate overall website visibility and performance

---

# Reflection

This experience helped strengthen my understanding of real-world analytics implementation, website tracking, and performance reporting using GA4 and related marketing analytics tools.
